mission_instrument: ISS and Space Shuttle, 2001 to 2009; cabin CO2 from the station's Major Constituent Analyzer and Shuttle sensors as summarized in NASA/TP-2010-216126

units.source_pdf_page: page of the 30 page PDF copy

preprocessing: Transcribed by hand from section 2.1 and 2.2 of the paper. co2_low and co2_high hold only numbers the text prints; blank means not printed. The paper itself summarizes these events from Felker (2003), not from raw data.
license_terms: NASA technical paper, public domain in the United States; the copy read is on a third-party host (see sources).
provenance: REPLAY. Event summaries printed in a NASA technical paper; not CO2 telemetry.
is_not: Not one-hour averages: the printed values are spot readings, peaks or ranges. Not a time series, and the symptom times are only dates or less.

consumers.use: CO2 act level and its guidance
Eval scenarios with a documented symptom or no symptom
